# FaMED Prep — independent preparation resources

FaMED Prep is independent of the official FaMed examination provider. Human-medicine facts checked18October2026; recheck changing fees, booking and authority conditions before publication.

## Current examination sources

- Format:https://famed-test.de/pruefungsablauf/
- Human-medicine practice test2026:https://famed-test.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/FaMed-Uebungstest_2-1.pdf
- Requirements:https://famed-test.de/anforderungen/
- Results:https://famed-test.de/pruefungsergebnis/
- Fee and centres:https://famed-test.de/faq/

Three stations/five tasks:history and consent; two patient presentations; written anamnesis from a video. Oral blocks23minutes including reading, individual situations maximum11minutes in the current practice PDF. Written task22minutes including video; complete sentences and appropriate reported speech. Each station requires60%. Medical knowledge is not separately assessed. No verified universal30-second preparation rule, pass-rate statistic or exam-case frequency.

FAQ lists€530 exam fee and Mainz/Kassel/Nürnberg as of the check date. Provider recognition overview is datedNovember2025; authority and qualification conditions govern. Passing the language exam does not itself issue Approbation or Berufserlaubnis.
